description: The specified at-most-\(n\) sentence holds in a structure \(M\) exactly when \(|M|\le n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.realize_atMostSentence.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (n : ℕ) : M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.atMostSentence L n ↔ Cardinal.mk M ≤ ↑n
